items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Well all of Dutres played with George.

ctx.x: And his dad too. And Pete, you know Pete Dutre. Yeah. Well all of Dutres played with George.
Now for years, Daddy played for the Jefferson City Buzzards. Oh. Many, many years in the carnival tree.
